Created `opencode.jsonc` at the repository root with:

- Model configuration (Claude Sonnet 4 + Haiku for small tasks)
- Instructions pointing to CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules
- Context7 and gitmcp MCP servers enabled
- Permission controls (ask before edits/bash, allow read-only commands)
- Custom commands for common operations (check, db-migrate, test-api)
- Biome formatter configuration
- Sharing disabled for security
